name: Starbrew Station: Auto-Maintenance Droid Unit
summary: The Auto-Maintenance Droid is a new Patron-role unit available for the Engineering Deck (Deck 2). This unit is a premium side-grade offering slightly better income efficiency and is intended for players who wish to optimize their station. The Droid produces 22 Coffee/s and acts as a higher-tier alternative to the free units on this deck.
